anchor.quote: Alaio may process User Personal Data in Russian Federation

findings.notes: Processing personal data in Russia under alleged Art 46 safeguards — the single most serious issue.

anchor.quote: notify Administrator of the Data Incident promptly and without undue delay

findings.notes: No fixed breach-notification deadline (cf GDPR Art 33).

anchor.quote: Alaio monitors a variety of communication channels for security breaches

findings.notes: Second location of the same breach-notification-timing issue — must collapse with g2a into ONE finding.

anchor.quote: Administrator may object to any new Sub-processor by notifying Alaio promptly in writing within five (5) business days

findings.notes: 5-business-day objection window is commercially unreasonable. mergeGroup with a2: one correctly-merged §7.4 finding may satisfy both.

anchor.quote: delete all Personal Data (including existing copies) from Bitrix24 systems

findings.notes: 90-day deletion window; no return-of-data option (cf Art 28(3)(g)).

anchor.quote: Administrator shall reimburse Alaio for any time expended by Alaio or its third-party Sub-processors for any such on-site inspection

findings.notes: Audit reimbursement at professional rates is a financial barrier to oversight.

anchor.quote: Alaio will inform the Administrator immediately if it believes that a data processing instruction violates the GDPR

findings.notes: Inform-duty limited to GDPR/EU while the DPA's own definition lists ~30 global laws (Art 28(3)(h) gap).

anchor.quote: Alaio may change this DPA if the change

findings.notes: Vendor unilaterally judges whether a change is materially adverse.

anchor.quote: shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of Republic of Cyprus

findings.notes: Foreign governing law.

anchor.quote: shall fall within the jurisdiction of the courts of Republic of Cyprus

findings.notes: Foreign forum — same theme as g8a; should collapse into one finding.

anchor.quote: Administrator may terminate the Agreement by giving written notice to Alaio within 30 days

findings.notes: Change-notice / termination mechanics — legitimate but low-importance.

anchor.quote: Before onboarding Sub-processors, Alaio conducts an audit of the security and privacy practices

findings.notes: No advance notice / objection right when appointing sub-processors (Art 28(2)).
The DPA has no liability provision / no GDPR-breach carve-out from the master-agreement cap. Absence — v1 cannot detect it.

anchor.quote: Alaio will use reasonable efforts to make available to Administrator a change in the Services

findings.notes: Objection remedy is illusory — only 'reasonable efforts' + terminate-the-service; no right to actually block the sub-processor. Anchor quote gates the match to §7.4.

anchor.quote: Alaio may update or modify such Security Measures from time to time

findings.notes: Vendor may unilaterally modify the Security Measures with only a soft 'no degradation' limit. Anchor quote gates the match to Appendix 2 (avoids colliding with the DPA-changes clause, which reuses the phrase 'degradation of the overall security').

anchor.quote: unsuccessful log-in attempts, pings, port scans, denial of service attacks

findings.notes: Excluding unsuccessful attempts / DoS that don't compromise data is MARKET-STANDARD (Google/AWS DPAs). Should NOT be a primary finding.

anchor.quote: BY CLICKING THE "I ACCEPT" BUTTON BELOW

findings.notes: Standard click-wrap acceptance for a self-serve product — contract-formation, out of scope for DPA negotiation.

anchor.quote: will not be construed as an acknowledgement by Alaio of any fault or liability

findings.notes: Standard no-admission-of-fault language. Soft trap.
Standard authorization warranty; v1 flags it GREEN with a cosmetic redline — low-value noise. Soft trap.

anchor.quote: If the Bitrix24 Customer Account is on a free plan

findings.notes: Real issue but a product/service term — expected YELLOW. v1 over-classifies it RED (same level as the Russia transfer).
